exact_conditional_criteria.current_total_message_differs: (L_m-L_n) T_l(H) !=0 at common H and shared feature transform.
exact_conditional_criteria.neighbor_message_differs: The corresponding off-node action difference is nonzero.
exact_conditional_criteria.next_state_differs: At common H/epsilon, total message change implies next-state change by real ELU injectivity; floating saturation and later cancellation remain limits.
exact_conditional_criteria.same_all_input_map: A_m=A_n where A_m=diag(s_m)Wdiag(r_m); fixed endpoint panel equality iff (A_m-A_n)Z=0.
exact_conditional_criteria.same_deployed_operator: Use native actual normalized/clamped sparse L, not raw F or detached unnormalized .L.

exact_site.private_sites: Ordered-incidence linear1 only, all layers; all original features/head/epsilon/slow incidence weights shared.

future_function_assay.conditional_fact: Truly function-equivalent compensated gauges give identical responses on all common external inputs.
future_function_assay.limits: A finite resolved difference identifies different functions on those inputs; it does not establish useful or causal evidence, operator gauge inequivalence or exclusion of node-frame adaptation.
future_function_assay.one_view: Same fixed label-free within-source-set feature permutation; query features/support unchanged; recompute full native recurrence.

gauge_limits: Edge-stalk orthogonal gauges leave Gram transport inputs unchanged; the bank explicitly realizes only the stated discrete row signs without further assumptions.
Node-frame operator conjugacy requires correct normalization/metric semantics; element clamps and training jitter matter.
Shared fixed feature maps, bias, epsilon and ELU/head do not confer whole-network orthogonal equivariance.
General tanh maps may be singular; paired transpose products are not automatically inverse transports or holonomy.
Equal spectra/block energies/probe actions do not certify complete gauge or predictor equality.

compare_levels: Actual normalized basis-probe/operator and current-value actions
initialization_and_contrast.sign_only_start: Raw factor/map differences can coexist with identical deployed transport and predictions.
initialization_and_contrast.unit_start: Same functions in exact eval before training; stochastic native draws can break training symmetry without guaranteeing useful diversity.

one_inactive_hypothesis.failure: Different irrelevant/noisy neighbor energies; zero right feature transform or head invisibility; stochastic-state/jitter spread; collapsed descriptors and zero initial kernel-distance gradient.
one_inactive_hypothesis.invariance: Edge-basis row-sign noops, and independent orthogonal block conjugacies of already deployed operators.
minimum_controls: Range-matched raw-map kernel with same coefficient/recipient and matched training/selection/RNG opportunity
one_inactive_hypothesis.not_inferred: Arbitrary native network frame equivariance, continuous gauge tangents, complete operator equivalence, or predictor utility.
one_inactive_hypothesis.restricted_update: theta receives F only; eta receives F plus0.1 times R_action gradient. Only first-layer eta has a direct nonzero auxiliary gradient in this definition.
one_inactive_hypothesis.scope: First-layer normalized off-node block action energies on fixed label-blind node-basis probes; future competent core required.

conditional_strength.construction: Two-node one-edge d4, F=a I4 at both endpoints; finite constant endpoint input coordinate and bias-free shared W.

discrete_row_sign.conditions: Same incoming states and normalization draws; eval jitter zero; apply by induction per layer.
discrete_row_sign.parameter_change: s_(a,b) -> sigma_a*s_(a,b), sigma_a in {-1,+1}, uniform across incidences at a layer.
